option_relations.rationale: Vitamin K-dependent coagulation factor deficiency syndrome does not match the clinical presentation of progressive skin laxity and elastic fiber calcification
Classic pseudoxanthoma elasticum is a subtype of Pseudoxanthoma Elasticum, which is characterized by elastic fiber calcification and skin laxity
Classical Pseudoxanthoma Elasticum (PXE) is equivalent to Pseudoxanthoma Elasticum, which is characterized by elastic fiber calcification and skin laxity

Pseudoxanthoma elasticum-like disorder with coagulation deficiency is a subtype of Pseudoxanthoma Elasticum, which is characterized by elastic fiber calcification and skin laxity, with additional coagulation deficiency
